fof: Given a person, list the names of their friends of friends (two knows-steps away).
forum_board_render: Given a forum, list its posts with their content and the full profile of each post's author.
friends: Given a person, list the first and last names of the people they know.
full_profile_page: Given a person, read each friend's full profile with their city name, universities (with class year) and companies (with start year).
ic1: Given a person and a first name, find the 20 people with that first name within three knows-steps, nearest first, with their profile, city, universities and companies.
ic10: Given a person and a month, recommend the 10 friends of friends born from the 21st of that month to the 22nd of the next, ranked by how many of their posts match the person's interests.
ic11: Given a person, a country and a year, find the 10 friends or friends of friends who started working at a company in that country before the year, earliest first.
ic12: Given a person and a tag class, find the 20 friends who most often replied to posts tagged with that class or any of its subclasses, with the tag names.
ic12_capped: Same as ic12, but the tag-class subclass tree is followed at most three levels deep.
ic2: Given a person and a date, find the 20 most recent messages created before that date by the person's friends, newest first.
ic2_merge: An alias of ic2: every format runs ic2's plan (no format runs a date-sorted merge plan).
ic2_nolimit: Same as ic2, but without the limit of 20: return all friends' messages before the date.
ic3: Given a person, two countries and a date window, find the 20 friends and friends of friends who posted in both countries in the window, ranked by message count.
ic3_getdate: Same as ic3, but the creationDate of every candidate message is read and then filtered, instead of taking the window from the date index.
ic4: Given a person and a date window, find the 10 tags most used on friends' posts in the window that no friend's post used before it.
ic5: Given a person and a date, find the 20 forums that friends and friends of friends joined after that date, ranked by how many posts those members made in them.
ic6: Given a person and a tag, find the 10 tags that most often appear together with it on posts by friends and friends of friends.
ic7: Given a person, find the 20 most recent likes of their messages, with each liker, the liked message, the like delay and whether the liker is a friend.
ic8: Given a person, find the 20 most recent replies to their messages, with each reply and its author.
ic8_merge: An alias of ic8: every format runs ic8's plan (no format runs a date-sorted merge plan).
ic9: Given a person and a date, find the 20 most recent messages created before that date by their friends and friends of friends, newest first.
ic9_merge: An alias of ic9: every format runs ic9's plan (no format runs a date-sorted merge plan).
is1: Given a person, read their profile (first and last name, birthday, IP address, browser, gender, creation date) and the id of their city.
is2: Given a person, find their 10 most recent messages, each with the original post of its thread and that post's author.
is2_capped: Same as is2, but the walk from a message up to its original post is capped at three replies.
is3: Given a person, list all their friends with the date the friendship began, newest first.
is4: Given a message, read its creation date and content.
is5: Given a message, find its author.
is6: Given a message, find the forum that contains it and the moderator of that forum.
is6_capped: Same as is6, but the walk from the message up to its original post is capped at three replies.
is7: Given a message, list its direct replies with each reply's author and whether that author knows the message's author.
knows: Given a person, list the names of the people they know.
liker_digest: Given a person, find the 20 most recent likes of their messages, with the full profile of each liker and the full liked message.
network_profile_digest: Given a person, list each friend with seven profile fields and the date the friendship began, newest friendship first.
profile_multiget: Given a person, read the full profile (eight properties) of each of their friends, in id order.
reply_thread_render: Given a message, list its direct replies with their content and each reply author's name.
